n: The Space Station Parts Pack contains everything needed to construct big, beautiful space stations. The pack includes the Kosmos VA capsule and TKS functional cargo block, a rugged and reliable vehicle for orbital operations, trusted by Kerbalnauts everywhere. n: Nehemiah Engineering Orbital Science is a collection of orbital science experiments aimed at prolonged station keeping. It consists of three distinct sets of experiments: * Kemini Research Program (KRP) - early-game experiments run from within a capsule based on real-life experiments run during the Gemini program. * Kerbal Environmental Effects Study (KEES) - mid-game experiments for attaching to the outside of a small station based on real-life material exposure experiments run on the MIR station. * Orbital Station Science (OSS) - Kerbal Life Science (KLS) and Orbital Material Science (OMS) - late-game large-scale station experiments based on real-life ISS experiments. These require modular station construction and maintenance. All of the experiments are designed to be run in the background while the player performs other missions.
s:
Nehemiah Engineering Orbital Science is a collection of orbital science experiments aimed at prolonged station keeping. It consists of three distinct sets of experiments:
* Kemini Research Program (KRP) - early-game experiments run from within a capsule based on real-life experiments run during the Gemini program.
* Kerbal Environmental Effects Study (KEES) - mid-game experiments for attaching to the outside of a small station based on real-life material exposure experiments run on the MIR station.
* Orbital Station Science (OSS) - Kerbal Life Science (KLS) and Orbital Material Science (OMS) - late-game large-scale station experiments based on real-life ISS experiments. These require modular station construction and maintenance.

All of the experiments are designed to be run in the background while the player performs other missions.
t:
Nehemiah Engineering Orbital Science 是一组面向长期空间站驻留的轨道科学实验合集，包含三套彼此独立的实验：
* Kemini 研究计划（KRP）——游戏前期实验，在舱内运行，基于双子座计划中进行的真实实验。
* Kerbal 环境影响研究（KEES）——游戏中期实验，安装于小型空间站外部，基于和平号空间站上进行的真实材料暴露实验。
* 轨道空间站科学（OSS）——Kerbal 生命科学（KLS）与轨道材料科学（OMS）——游戏后期的大型空间站实验，基于国际空间站的真实实验。这些需要模块化空间站建造与维护。

所有实验均设计为在玩家执行其他任务时于后台运行。

n: With Archipelago for KSP, you start with a small selection of random parts and must perform missions to unlock additional parts to get closer to your goal. Any time you achieve something for the first time such as orbiting a planet, taking a surface sample, planting a flag, etc., you will unlock new parts for yourself or other players in their games. Goals are selected by the player when they generate a new game, and things like flying to Duna and back, planting a flag on all bodies, returning a surface sample from every body are default goals players can chose from.
s:
With Archipelago for KSP, you start with a small selection of random parts and must perform missions to unlock additional parts to get closer to your goal. Any time you achieve something for the first time such as orbiting a planet, taking a surface sample, planting a flag, etc., you will unlock new parts for yourself or other players in their games.
Goals are selected by the player when they generate a new game, and things like flying to Duna and back, planting a flag on all bodies, returning a surface sample from every body are default goals players can chose from.
t:
借助 Archipelago for KSP，你从一小批随机部件开始，必须执行任务来解锁更多部件，逐步接近目标。每当你首次达成某项成就，例如环绕行星、采集地表样本、插旗等，你都会为自己或其他玩家在其游戏中解锁新部件。
目标由玩家在生成新游戏时选择，诸如往返 Duna、在所有天体上插旗、从每个天体带回地表样本等，均为玩家可选的默认目标。

n: Kerems TUFX is a realistic, cinematic TUFX profile that gives KSP a NASA-like look. Perfect for players who want a clean, professional, and realistic look during launches, orbit, and landings.
s: Kerems TUFX is a realistic, cinematic TUFX profile that gives KSP a NASA-like look. With ACES tone mapping, soft bloom, subtle chromatic aberration, and light ambient occlusion, you get bright daylight scenes, beautiful re-entry glow, and true-to-life colors without exaggeration. Perfect for players who want a clean, professional, and realistic look during launches, orbit, and landings.
t: Kerems TUFX 是一款写实、电影感的 TUFX 配置文件，赋予 KSP 类似 NASA 的观感。凭借 ACES 色调映射、柔和泛光、细微色差与轻度环境光遮蔽，你能获得明亮的日照场景、优美的再入辉光与真实自然的色彩，毫不夸张。非常适合追求干净、专业、写实观感的玩家，用于发射、轨道与着陆阶段。

n: On Demand Fuel Cells (ODFC) is a plugin to simulate fuel cells in Kerbal Space Program (KSP), and do a better job of it than stock's use of a resource converter. The main difference is it only generates electricity when it's really needed (batteries almost empty), and otherwise lets electricity of a craft float up and down, as it might in a solar powered vehicle when the sun is eclipsed by another celestial body. It also allows fuel cells to generate byproducts, aimed at supporting life support mods like TACLS.
s: On Demand Fuel Cells (ODFC) is a plugin to simulate fuel cells in Kerbal Space Program (KSP), and do a better job of it than stock's use of a resource converter.  The main difference is it only generates electricity when it's really needed (batteries almost empty), and otherwise lets electricity of a craft float up and down, as it might in a solar powered vehicle when the sun is eclipsed by another celestial body.  It also allows fuel cells to generate byproducts, aimed at supporting life support mods like TACLS.
t: 按需燃料电池（ODFC）是一个在坎巴拉太空计划（KSP）中模拟燃料电池的插件，效果比原版使用资源转化炉更好。主要区别在于：它只在真正需要时（电池几乎耗尽）才发电，其余时间则让飞船电量自然浮动，就像太阳能飞行器在太阳被其他天体遮挡时的情形。它还允许燃料电池产生副产物，用于支持 TACLS 之类的生命维持 mod。

n: Contrails adds condensation trails behind air-breathing engines at high altitude, so your jets leave the white streaks you see in the real sky. The trail is attached to every engine that breathes air, which means turbojets, ramjets, piston engines and rotors work too, including those from Advanced Jet Engine. Rockets get nothing, and electric propellers are skipped on purpose. Two modes, switched in settings.cfg: arcade - a bold, War Thunder style trail; realistic - thin crisp lines right behind the nozzles that spread within a few seconds into a wide, lumpy band, matching real photos. Everything is tunable in GameData/Contrails/settings.cfg: altitude limits and the fade band around them, trail lifetime, growth, opacity, nozzle gap, fade-in time, shadow strength and emission rate. With "Vapour as particles" enabled the trail is drawn as volumetric cloud puffs instead of a ribbon, and the puffs themselves have quality, spacing and layer count settings. An in-game settings window (via Toolbar Controller) applies changes while you fly and can save your favourite setups as presets. The window is available in Russian and English.
s:
Contrails adds condensation trails behind air-breathing engines at high
altitude, so your jets leave the white streaks you see in the real sky.

The trail is attached to every engine that breathes air, which means
turbojets, ramjets, piston engines and rotors work too, including those
from Advanced Jet Engine. Rockets get nothing, and electric propellers are
skipped on purpose.

Two modes, switched in settings.cfg:

  arcade     - a bold, War Thunder style trail;
  realistic  - thin crisp lines right behind the nozzles that spread within
               a few seconds into a wide, lumpy band, matching real photos.

Everything is tunable in GameData/Contrails/settings.cfg: altitude limits
and the fade band around them, trail lifetime, growth, opacity, nozzle gap,
fade-in time, shadow strength and emission rate. With "Vapour as particles"
enabled the trail is drawn as volumetric cloud puffs instead of a ribbon,
and the puffs themselves have quality, spacing and layer count settings.

An in-game settings window (via Toolbar Controller) applies changes while
you fly and can save your favourite setups as presets. The window is
available in Russian and English.
t:
Contrails 为高空中的吸气式发动机添加凝结尾迹，让你的喷气机在天空中留下真实照片里那样的白色条纹。

尾迹会附加到每一台吸气式发动机上，因此涡喷、冲压、活塞发动机和旋翼同样适用，包括 Advanced Jet Engine 的部件。火箭不会产生尾迹，电动螺旋桨则刻意跳过。

两种模式，在 settings.cfg 中切换：

  街机     - 醒目的 War Thunder 风格尾迹；
  真实     - 喷口后方纤细清晰的线条，几秒内扩散成宽阔而起伏的带状，与真实照片一致。

所有内容均可在 GameData/Contrails/settings.cfg 中调整：高度限制及其周围的淡出带、尾迹寿命、扩散、不透明度、喷口间隙、淡入时间、阴影强度和发射率。启用“蒸汽作为粒子”后，尾迹会以体积云团而非带状绘制，云团本身也有质量、间距和层数设置。

游戏内设置窗口（通过 Toolbar Controller）可在飞行中应用更改，并可将喜爱的配置保存为预设。窗口支持俄语和英语。

n: MKS introduces a series of parts specifically designed to provide self-sustaining life support for your Kerbals. While the parts will function without a life support mod, the design is centered around providing an appropriate challenge where players will weigh the costs, risks, and rewards of supplying missions exclusively with carried life support supplies, or in making the investment in a permanent colony. That being said, this is not just a single greenhouse part (although food production is part of the mod). Rather, it brings an entire colonization end-game to KSP in a fun and challenging way.
s: MKS introduces a series of parts specifically designed to provide self-sustaining life support for your Kerbals. While the parts will function without a life support mod, the design is centered around providing an appropriate challenge where players will weigh the costs, risks, and rewards of supplying missions exclusively with carried life support supplies, or in making the investment in a permanent colony. That being said, this is not just a single greenhouse part (although food production is part of the mod). Rather, it brings an entire colonization end-game to KSP in a fun and challenging way.
t: MKS 引入了一系列专为 Kerbal 提供自给自足生命保障而设计的部件。这些部件在没有生命保障 mod 的情况下也能运作，但其设计核心在于提供恰当的挑战：玩家需权衡仅靠携带的生命保障补给维持任务，还是投资建设永久殖民地，各自的成本、风险与回报。话虽如此，这并不只是一个温室部件（尽管食物生产也是其中一部分），而是以有趣且富有挑战性的方式为 KSP 带来了完整的殖民终局。

n: With the stock editor now supporting custom filters in a reasonable way, creating more and better filters is the next logical step. However, the requirement for categories to be managed via code is just a terrible idea. Not to mention that there is no easy way to be compatible with anyone else. Filter extensions allows the usage of .cfg files to create, edit, or delete all categories and sub-categories. It uses standard config files, and as such patches can be applied, and dependencies allowed for using Module Manager.
s: With the stock editor now supporting custom filters in a reasonable way, creating more and better filters is the next logical step. However, the requirement for categories to be managed via code is just a terrible idea. Not to mention that there is no easy way to be compatible with anyone else. Filter extensions allows the usage of .cfg files to create, edit, or delete all categories and sub-categories. It uses standard config files, and as such patches can be applied, and dependencies allowed for using Module Manager.
t: 原版编辑器如今已能以合理方式支持自定义筛选器，因此制作更多、更好的筛选器是顺理成章的下一步。然而，要求通过代码来管理分类实在是个糟糕的主意，更不用说这样做很难与他人保持兼容。Filter Extensions 允许使用 .cfg 文件创建、编辑或删除所有分类与子分类。它采用标准配置文件，因此可以应用补丁，并可借助 Module Manager 声明依赖。

n: This mod adds several large parts designed to be integrated into a permanent space station: the Science Lab, the Zoology Bay, the Cyclotron, and the Spectrometron. These heavy parts provide facilities for performing experiments. Experiments are held in small, light pods that you can dock with your space station, execute, and bring back to the surface for Science points. The Spectrometron uses the Cyclotron to analyze Surface Samples that you've brought into orbit, and allows you to transmit the data home for full value. In addition, there are tanks for storing Kibbal for the Zoology Bay.
s: This mod adds several large parts designed to be integrated into a permanent space station: the Science Lab, the Zoology Bay, the Cyclotron, and the Spectrometron. The Spectrometron uses the Cyclotron to analyze Surface Samples that you've brought into orbit, and allows you to transmit the data home for full value. In addition, there are tanks for storing Kibbal for the Zoology Bay.

n: For most fusion engines (and reactors) in FarFutureTechnologies: Introduces deuterium-tritium (D-T) fusion as an option. Craft Manager is a replacement for the stock craft list in the editors that adds a bunch features the stock list lacks and opens much faster.
Search, Sort and Organize your craft, view and load craft from any save, move/copy them between saves, transfer them between editors, load your subassemblies in the same interface.
Craft can be tagged with custom tags which you can manually assign. Tags can also be given a rule so they also auto associate with craft.
t:
Craft Manager 是编辑器中原版飞行器列表的替代品，添加了原版列表所缺少的众多功能，且打开速度快得多。
搜索、排序与整理你的飞行器，查看并加载任意存档中的飞行器，在存档之间移动/复制它们，在编辑器之间转移，并在同一界面中加载你的子装配。
飞行器可用自定义标签手动标记。标签还可设定规则，从而自动与飞行器关联。

n: Adds a numeric keypad lock to every command part - probe cores and crewed pods alike. Set a code in the VAB, engage the lock, and the craft will not pitch, roll, yaw, throttle, stage or fire an action group until somebody types the code back in. Crew cannot EVA out, nobody can board in, and the vessel cannot be recovered or terminated without the PIN unless it is parked on a launch pad or runway. One craft has one lock and one PIN however many command parts it carries. The two Aegis buttons stay reachable in the part menu while locked, so a craft can always be opened again. Attached by ModuleManager, so it covers modded command parts as well as stock ones.
s: Adds a numeric keypad lock to every command part - probe cores and crewed pods alike. Set a code in the VAB, engage the lock, and the craft will not pitch, roll, yaw, throttle, stage or fire an action group until somebody types the code back in. Crew cannot EVA out, nobody can board in, and the vessel cannot be recovered or terminated without the PIN unless it is parked on a launch pad or runway. One craft has one lock and one PIN however many command parts it carries. The two Aegis buttons stay reachable in the part menu while locked, so a craft can always be opened again. Attached by ModuleManager, so it covers modded command parts as well as stock ones.
t: 为每个指令部件——探测核心与载人舱皆同——添加数字键盘锁。在 VAB 中设定密码并启用锁定后，在有人重新输入密码之前，飞船不会俯仰、滚转、偏航、调节节流阀、分级或触发动作组。乘员无法 EVA 出舱，任何人无法登船；除非停放在发射台或跑道上，否则没有 PIN 就无法回收或终止飞船。无论飞船装有多少个指令部件，一艘飞船只有一把锁和一个 PIN。锁定期间，部件菜单中的两个 Aegis 按钮仍可使用，因此飞船总能重新解锁。以 ModuleManager 方式挂载，因此原版与 mod 指令部件均适用。

n: Adds a working observatory to KSP, alongside the stock science system rather than in place of it. Photograph anything in the sky, from moons to galaxies, through real named telescopes (a PlaneWave astrograph, the VLT, a launchable space telescope) onto real detector models, and get FITS files that calibrate and stack in real astronomy software. Or run an actual exoplanet survey: select a real star from an exoplanet.eu-derived catalog, choose an instrument suited to its brightness and detection method, and extract a signal from simulated, photon-noise-limited data. Includes transit timing variations (TTV), the Rossiter-McLaughlin effect, and a career-mode instrument-acquisition economy. Everything works out of the box; the optional sky data (Gaia star field, dust, galaxies and their images) is downloaded by tools/get_sky_data_compact.py or tools/get_sky_data_complete.py, and is not required.
s: Adds a working observatory to KSP, alongside the stock science system rather than in place of it. Photograph anything in the sky, from moons to galaxies, through real named telescopes (a PlaneWave astrograph, the VLT, a launchable space telescope) onto real detector models, and get FITS files that calibrate and stack in real astronomy software. Or run an actual exoplanet survey: select a real star from an exoplanet.eu-derived catalog, choose an instrument suited to its brightness and detection method, and extract a signal from simulated, photon-noise-limited data. Includes transit timing variations (TTV), the Rossiter-McLaughlin effect, and a career-mode instrument-acquisition economy. Everything works out of the box; the optional sky data (Gaia star field, dust, galaxies and their images) is downloaded by tools/get_sky_data_compact.py or tools/get_sky_data_complete.py, and is not required.
t: 为 KSP 添加一座可运作的天文台，与原有科学系统并存，而非取代它。通过真实命名的望远镜（PlaneWave 天体照相仪、VLT、可发射的太空望远镜）拍摄天空中的任何目标，从卫星到星系，成像于真实的探测器模型上，并获得可在真实天文软件中校准与叠加的 FITS 文件。或者进行一次真正的系外行星巡天：从源自 exoplanet.eu 的星表中选取一颗真实恒星，选择适合其亮度和探测方法的仪器，从受光子噪声限制的模拟数据中提取信号。包含凌星时刻变化（TTV）、Rossiter-McLaughlin 效应，以及生涯模式下的仪器采购经济系统。一切开箱即用；可选的星空数据（Gaia 星场、尘埃、星系及其图像）由 tools/get_sky_data_compact.py 或 tools/get_sky_data_complete.py 下载，并非必需。

n: Do you fly Mk3 spaceplanes and need to haul lots of stuff into space? The Kerbal Inventory System (KIS) from the brilliant team of KospY and Winn75 provides a framework for doing just that. However, you have to attach containers to the outside of your spaceplane, which is not very aerodynamic. To answer this demand, RocketWorks has developed three KIS Containers that fit inside the Mk3 CRG Cargo Bays: Mk3 KIS Small Container (5000L), Mks3 KIS Medium Container (10000L), Mk3 KIS Long Container (20000L). You can, of course, install upto four Small Containers inside the CRG-100 Cargo Bay. To install a Container in a Cargo Bay, first place a Mk3 KIS Mount on the floor of the Cargo Bay. This Mount is a ruggedized version of the KospY/Winn75 KIS "SM-62 Container mount". It has been enlarged strengthened to handle the additional stresses of the new containers. Then, drop a Container on to the mount. Right-click the KIS container and load-up whatever you need to haul into space.
s: Do you fly Mk3 spaceplanes and need to haul lots of stuff into space?  The Kerbal Inventory System (KIS) from the brilliant team of KospY and Winn75 provides a framework for doing just that.  However, you have to attach containers to the outside of your spaceplane, which is not very aerodynamic.   To answer this demand, RocketWorks has developed three KIS Containers that fit inside the Mk3 CRG Cargo Bays: Mk3 KIS Small Container (5000L), Mks3 KIS Medium Container (10000L), Mk3 KIS Long Container (20000L).  You can, of course, install upto four Small Containers inside the CRG-100 Cargo Bay.  To install a Container in a Cargo Bay, first place a Mk3 KIS Mount on the floor of the Cargo Bay.  This Mount is a ruggedized version of the KospY/Winn75 KIS "SM-62 Container mount".  It has been enlarged strengthened to handle the additional stresses of the new containers.  Then, drop a Container on to the mount.  Right-click the KIS container and load-up whatever you need to haul into space.
t: 你驾驶 Mk3 太空飞机，需要把大量物资送入太空吗？由 KospY 和 Winn75 组成的出色团队开发的 Kerbal Inventory System（KIS）为此提供了框架。然而，你必须把容器挂在太空飞机外部，这会影响气动性能。为满足这一需求，RocketWorks 开发了三种可装入 Mk3 CRG 货舱的 KIS 容器：Mk3 KIS 小容器（5000L）、Mks3 KIS 中容器（10000L）、Mk3 KIS 长容器（20000L）。当然，你可以在 CRG-100 货舱内安装最多四个小容器。要在货舱内安装容器，首先在货舱地板上放置一个 Mk3 KIS 安装座。该安装座是 KospY/Winn75 的 KIS“SM-62 容器安装座”的加固版本，经过放大与加强，以承受新容器带来的额外应力。然后，将一个容器放到安装座上。右键点击 KIS 容器，装载你需要送入太空的任何物资。

n: Kerbal Weather Project - Lite is pared down version of the original weather and climate mod for KSP. In KWP-Lite, weather and climate data from the Model for Prediction Across Scales (MPAS) were incorporated into KSP gameplay. KWP-Lite includes a reduced resolution global Hourly climatology from MPAS allowing players to experience diurnal and spatial variations in atmospheric conditions. In addition, one year of point weather data from MPAS is provided at Kerbin launch sites, allowing players to experience dynamic weather conditions that change daily. KWP-Lite features a text-based GUI showing remote sensing weather data (in space) and in situ weather data (in the atmosphere).
s: Kerbal Weather Project - Lite is pared down version of the original weather and climate mod for KSP. In KWP-Lite, weather and climate data from the Model for Prediction Across Scales (MPAS) were incorporated into KSP gameplay. KWP-Lite includes a reduced resolution global Hourly climatology from MPAS allowing players to experience diurnal and spatial variations in atmospheric conditions. In addition, one year of point weather data from MPAS is provided at Kerbin launch sites, allowing players to experience dynamic weather conditions that change daily. KWP-Lite features a text-based GUI showing remote sensing weather data (in space) and in situ weather data (in the atmosphere).
t: Kerbal Weather Project - Lite 是 KSP 原天气与气候模组的精简版。在 KWP-Lite 中，来自跨尺度预测模型（MPAS）的天气与气候数据被融入 KSP 玩法。KWP-Lite 包含 MPAS 提供的降低分辨率全球逐时气候学数据，让玩家体验大气条件的昼夜与空间变化。此外，Kerbin 发射场还提供 MPAS 为期一年的单点天气数据，让玩家体验逐日变化的动态天气条件。KWP-Lite 提供一个基于文本的 GUI，显示遥感天气数据（太空中）与原位天气数据（大气内）。

n: I think that a lot of us agree that its the little details in games that make the biggest difference. With that in mind myself and Rob Forrest have set out to make a mod pack with all the little things that you dont see in the game. While this pack is mostly oriented towards an RP that we a part of and as such will feature mostly military related items, we will take requests for non military things as well and will respond to as many as possible. So let us know what you think so far and what you think should be included in the future. Thanks for your support and enjoy!

t: 我认为很多人都同意，游戏中真正带来最大差别的是那些小细节。有鉴于此，我和 Rob Forrest 开始制作一个包含游戏中你见不到的各种小物件的模组包。虽然此包主要面向我们参与的一个角色扮演项目，因此大多为军事相关物品，但我们也会接受非军事物品的请求，并尽可能多地回应。所以请告诉我们你目前的看法，以及你认为未来应包含什么。感谢支持，祝玩得开心。

n: On Demand Fuel Cells (ODFC) is a plugin to support fuel cells that only generate power when it is needed, thereby saving precious fuel. Simulates fuel cells in Kerbal Space Program (KSP), and do a better job of it than stock's use of a resource converter. The main difference is it only generates electricity when it's really needed (batteries almost empty), and otherwise lets electricity of a craft float up and down, as it might in a solar powered vehicle when the sun is eclipsed by another celestial body. It also allows fuel cells to generate byproducts, aimed at supporting life support mods like TACLS.
s: On Demand Fuel Cells (ODFC) is a plugin to support fuel cells that only generate power when it is needed, thereby saving precious fuel. Simulates fuel cells in Kerbal Space Program (KSP), and do a better job of it than stock's use of a resource converter.  The main difference is it only generates electricity when it's really needed (batteries almost empty), and otherwise lets electricity of a craft float up and down, as it might in a solar powered vehicle when the sun is eclipsed by another celestial body.  It also allows fuel cells to generate byproducts, aimed at supporting life support mods like TACLS.
t: On Demand Fuel Cells（ODFC）是一个支持按需发电燃料电池的插件，仅在需要时发电，从而节省宝贵的燃料。它在 KSP 中模拟燃料电池，效果优于原版使用资源转化炉的做法。主要区别在于它只在真正需要时（电池几乎耗尽）才发电，其余时候让飞行器的电量自然浮动，就像太阳能飞行器在太阳被其他天体遮挡时那样。它还允许燃料电池产生副产品，以支持 TACLS 等生命维持 mod。

n: Kerbal Weather Project (KWP) is a groundbreaking weather and climate mod for KSP. In KWP, weather and climate data from the Model for Prediction Across Scales (MPAS) were incorporated into KSP gameplay. KWP includes a global Hourly climatology from MPAS enabling players to experience diurnal and spatial variations in atmospheric conditions. In addition, point weather data from MPAS is provided at Kerbin launch sites, allowing payers to experience dynamic weather conditions that change daily. KWP features a text-based GUI showing remote sensing weather data (in space) and in situ weather data (in the atmosphere).
s: Kerbal Weather Project (KWP) is a groundbreaking weather and climate mod for KSP. In KWP, weather and climate data from the Model for Prediction Across Scales (MPAS) were incorporated into KSP gameplay. KWP includes a global Hourly climatology from MPAS enabling players to experience diurnal and spatial variations in atmospheric conditions. In addition, point weather data from MPAS is provided at Kerbin launch sites, allowing payers to experience dynamic weather conditions that change daily. KWP features a text-based GUI showing remote sensing weather data (in space) and in situ weather data (in the atmosphere).
t: Kerbal Weather Project (KWP) 是 KSP 的一款开创性天气与气候 mod。KWP 将跨尺度预测模型（MPAS）的天气与气候数据融入 KSP 玩法。KWP 包含来自 MPAS 的全球逐小时气候数据，让玩家体验大气条件的昼夜与空间变化。此外，MPAS 的点位气象数据被提供于 Kerbin 发射场，使玩家体验逐日变化的动态天气条件。KWP 提供基于文本的 GUI，显示遥感气象数据（太空中）与原位气象数据（大气中）。

n: The Minor Planets Expansion (MPE) is made to work along-side the glorious Outer Planets Mod to make a more complete analogue to our real solar system. It does so by adding a total of 15 new objects, from asteroids to dwarf planets! All of which use hand-drawn heightmaps, have biome maps, and even science definitions!
s: The Minor Planets Expansion (MPE) is made to work along-side the glorious Outer Planets Mod to make a more complete analogue to our real solar system. It does so by adding a total of 15 new objects, from asteroids to dwarf planets! All of which use hand-drawn heightmaps, have biome maps, and even science definitions!
t: 小行星扩展（MPE）旨在与辉煌的 Outer Planets Mod 协同工作，以更完整地模拟我们真实的太阳系。它通过添加总共 15 个新天体（从小行星到矮行星）来实现这一点。所有这些天体都使用手绘高度图，拥有生态群系图，甚至还有科学定义。
